presenterResetTimer: Elapsed time — tap to restart from zero
presenterOpenAudience: Show on another screen (second monitor / projector)
presenterNoExternalDisplay: No external display. Connect a monitor/projector (HDMI, USB-C) or cast the screen, then try again.
presenterAudienceOpened: Audience screen opened — press F11 in that window if it is not full screen yet
presenterNotesSaveFailed: Presenter notes could not be saved: {error}
